references.observed: Broad flattened snout, tiny lateral eyes and closed anterior mouth, five long gill slits, longitudinal ridges, varied pale spots and thin grid lines, opaque thick swept fins and unequal caudal lobes.

limitations: Original Rhincodon typus visual study based on the inspected Erik Schlogl photograph. The broad mouth is closed; filter-feeding mechanics, fine denticles and teeth are simplified. Gill slits use shallow original relief, and movement is artist-tuned rather than measured.
